about: Ultra-high-purity (UHP) gases are typically 99.999% pure or better and are used where trace impurities would affect results — gas chromatography, spectroscopy, electronics work and instrument calibration. Purity is only as good as the regulator and lines used, so use stainless-steel, leak-tight hardware.
Ask for a certificate of analysis where you need documented purity.

faq.question: What does 99.999% purity mean?
faq.answer: It means 99.999% of the gas is the named gas, with no more than 10 ppm of impurities in total.

faq.question: Where can I buy ultra high purity gas in Nagpur?
faq.answer: Sunrise Gases supplies UHP gases from Nagpur. Call or WhatsApp with the gas, purity and quantity you need.
